g.text: VBUS_SENSE = VM x 27k/(540k+27k): 2.00 V at 42 V, 2.86 V at 60 V. Set the firmware overvoltage trip below the hardware transient ceiling.

g.desc: VBUS_SENSE = VM x 27k/(540k+27k): 2.00 V at 42 V, 2.86 V at 60 V. Set the firmware overvoltage trip below the hardware transient ceiling.

g.text: ERC sources: connector input / passive-filtered regulator outputs / internal bootstrap supplies.

g.text: R102/C107 and D101 are DNP tuning positions. Select only after cable/hot-plug measurements; they are not functional requirements for first power-up.

g.text: PLACEMENT: keep all three 680 uF capacitors close to the bridge bus. Fit local 1 uF + 10 nF / 100 V ceramics at each power block.
